# age PUBLIC key(s) the nightly backup encrypts to — one per line.
#
# Only a PUBLIC key belongs here (it starts with "age1"). Its private half is held by
# the owner, outside GitHub and outside Cloudflare, so nobody else can open the backups.
# How to make one, and how to unlock a backup: docs/BACKUP-RESTORE.md, "The backup key".
#
# Until a line starting with age1 is added below, the nightly backup job fails at its
# lock step and uploads NOTHING to GitHub. The dumps still reach the private R2 bucket.
